decision: scoped to six engines that run on this Mac CPU: NeMo FastPitch+HiFi-GAN, NeMo VITS, Kokoro, Piper, MMS-TTS, Edge TTS
why: user wants fast, accurate English and Bangla; Piper bn_BD, MMS ben and Edge bn-BD cover Bangla; Kyutai needs CUDA and stays an experiment
evidence: piperhub bn_BD google medium card; mms-tts-ben card

decision: skipped architect/arena; one ModelSpec registry plus one engine class per model family
why: the shape is concrete and every consumer (server, benchmark, download) only needs list-voices and synthesize
kokoro-onnx needs numpy>=2; NeMo 3 was resolved by default and its TTS API is unverified; 2.7.3 imports cleanly with numpy 2.5
evidence: uv lock output; import check printed ok 2.7.3 2.5.5

decision: all six engines synthesize English and Bangla where claimed

why: the CPU path made the benchmark take over 15 minutes for 20 clips
result: switch default ASR device to auto

decision: Whisper turbo gives 17% CER on Edge Bangla, a near-human voice

decision: replaced Whisper with NeMo Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 (English) and hishab Conformer (Bangla)
